messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by maya for change window at 22:00 UTC — config-only rollout for routing service. Canary=5% for 15m, auto-promote on green.

maya: Quick context — tuning batching + route weights to reduce head-of-line latency for short prompts. No model changes. Will target staging then canary.

tom: Which params exactly? I saw previous tweaks caused higher tail p99 for long sequences.

maya: Good call. Changes: batch_window: 40ms -> 25ms, max_batch_tokens: 2048 -> 1024, route_policy: prefer-low-latency for tier=free. Also tighten per-tenant token limit to 2k.

liam: Can we pin enterprise tenants to the old policy during canary? We should avoid regressions for paying customers.

maya: Yes — plan is to pin tenant-ids [acct:alpha, acct:gamma] to routing_policy: legacy during canary. If metrics look good after 15m we remove pins and roll to 50%.

elena: Observability checklist: heatmap for seq-length distribution, p50/p95/p99 latency per-tenant, kv-cache hit rate, errors/sec. I added dashboards and alertplay if p99 > baseline + 15%.

tom: Add a short abort condition: if p99 increases by >10% for enterprise tenants or error rate > 0.5/s for any canary node, we rollback.

maya: Done. Rollback command if needed:
```
/deploy rollback --service=routing --from=canary --to=stable --reason="routing config regression"
```

deploy-bot: Canary started: 5% traffic to config-v2-slim at 22:00:30 UTC. Deploy ID: db-6185551234. Monitor channel: #eng-releases.

liam: Seeing slight p50 improvement, p99 unchanged so far. KV hit stable. Keeping eyes on enterprise pins.

elena: Enterprise pinned tenants live on legacy policy — verifying traffic split with tenant filter. :eyes:

tom: If we need immediate throttle, can we temporarily set batch_window back via remote flags? I know runtime supports fastpatch:
```
rtctl set-flag routing.batch_window 40ms --scope=canary
```

maya: Yes, that's our quick mitigation. Ops will be on standby. If auto-promote hits 50% we hold for manual signoff.

deploy-bot: Canary at 15m: health=green, p99 delta=+2%, errors=0.02/s. Auto-promote to 50% in 2m unless veto.

elena: Veto for auto-promote from my side — want another 15m to watch enterprise latency under load. Holding.

maya: Acknowledged. Extending hold for 15m. No promo.

liam: Noted a tiny uptick in tail for sequences >3k tokens but those are outside our new token cap. Good to hold and verify customer impact.

tom: If we keep hold, update release notes: note token cap and route_policy change so SEs are aware.

maya: On it. Draft release note snippet:
"Config-only: reduced batch_window to 25ms, lowered max_batch_tokens to 1024, enabled prefer-low-latency route for free tier, temporary per-tenant pinning for enterprise during canary."

deploy-bot: Manual hold recorded by elena. Next check-in in 15m. If anyone needs to force rollback, use the rollback command above and ping @oncall.

elena: Thanks — will run another perf sweep at +10m. :thumbsup:
